description: This file defines the NotesListScreen React component for a notes app. It manages displaying a list of notes, including searching, refreshing, and interaction with other components like header, note cards, bottom navigation, and floating action button.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches all notes using listNotes() and updates the state with the retrieved notes.

methods.name: onRefresh
methods.description: Handles pull-to-refresh logic: shows the refreshing indicator, reloads notes, and hides the indicator.
